== Summary ==
The Target Field scoreboard message in memory of [[John Anderson]], shown at the Minnesota Twins vs. Detroit Tigers game on Friday 23 August 2019, the opening night of the [[2019 North American Continental Championship]] (the John Anderson Memorial Tournament). Minnesota SWCCG players bought a block of tickets to the game in honour of John's love of baseball, in place of a team tournament, and a donor paid for the scoreboard dedication. This is the official photo the team gave the group; John's family received the hard copy.

* '''Date:''' 23 August 2019 (game); posted 17 September 2019
* '''Image:''' native forum attachment

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1272925#p1272925 post 1272925] in topic 72589 ("Tigers @ Twins, 8/23 (Group Outing Friday)"), by imrahil327, 17 September 2019: "Here is the official picture of the scoreboard message for John. The family will be receiving the hard copy that we received from the team." Original attachment name: In memory of John Anderson.jpg; forum attachment id 9326. Preserved copy: pending (#1310).
